context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the security-check instructions from the published Rails Agent Skills tile.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Check authentication and authorization boundaries.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Check parameter handling and sensitive attribute assignment.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Check redirects, rendering, and output encoding.

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Check file handling, network calls, and background job inputs.

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Check secrets, logging, and operational exposure.

checklist.name: instruction-6
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Verify each finding:** Confirm it is exploitable with a concrete attack scenario before reporting. Exclude false positives (e.g., `html_safe` on a developer-defined constant, not user input).

checklist.name: instruction-7
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Format**: Sections must appear in the order below, even when empty — write "No issues found" and state what evidence would be needed to verify the category.

checklist.name: instruction-8
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Do not use representative file paths as if they were confirmed evidence.
